what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Norway, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1656 Somali refugees in Norway, 0.2% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1992 to 2025, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents since 2006.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1997 at 2208 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 9275, at the end of 2013; the main years of displacement in the data are 2001 to 2020.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Norway.
These are year-end totals for Norway only, reported to UNHCR.
